name: check_md_links
description: Scans all .md files under a docs dir for broken relative links (missing files or missing #fragment headings, ignoring fenced code and http/https/mailto), writes broken.json (sorted, unique '<file>: <target>' strings) and returns the count and list.
whenToUse: When asked to find broken relative Markdown links in docs/; re-run after docs change.

docs.description: Docs dir relative to project root

out.description: Output JSON path relative to project root

provenance.reason: docs link check will be requested repeatedly as docs are rewritten
